Roadmap

What comes next is partly up to you.

Each item is a GitHub issue. Vote with a 👍 on the issue, and the lists here are sorted by those votes. Something missing? Propose it in Discussions → Ideas.

Votes as of 2026-11-21: this page is a snapshot, updated when the site is published. No dates are promised: Pointe is community-supported, on a best-effort basis.

  • Vote with a 👍 reaction on an item's issue. A "+1" comment is not counted.
  • Propose new ideas in Discussions. Ideas that gather support become roadmap issues.
  • Triage about once a week: the maintainers move items between Now, Next and Later. Votes inform the order.
  • Build one. Items marked good first issue or help wanted are open to you: how to contribute.
